chunks: And it was narrated from Yūnus ibn Yaʿqūb, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a man performing an independent ʿUmrah Mufradah, so he said: "When you see Dhā Ṭuwā, stop the talbiyah."

key_terms.التَّلْبِيَةَ: the pilgrimage invocation recited in the state of ihram
key_terms.ذَا طُوًى: Dhā Ṭuwā, a known place near Makkah marking the point mentioned in the ruling
key_terms.عُمْرَةً مُفْرَدَةً: an independent ʿumrah performed separately from hajj

ai.seo_question: When should a person performing ʿUmrah Mufradah stop reciting the talbiyah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding ʿUmrah Mufradah. It states that the one performing it should discontinue the talbiyah upon seeing Dhā Ṭuwā, identifying a specific point at which the pilgrimage recitation ends.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2956 - It was narrated from Yunus ibn Ya'qub, who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah (as) about a man performing an independent Umrah Mufradah.
Imam (as) said: "When you see Dhu Tuwa, stop the Talbiyah."
